title: All Things Must Pass
notes:
Package design and photography for Camouflage Productions.

On labels:
Mfd. in U.K.
℗ 1970
An E.M.I. Recording

All songs published by Harrisongs Essex Int. except A1 Harrisongs Feldman, B2 Feldman, E2 Peter Maurice, World Music 
Mecolico. BIEM. NCB., except A1.

A1 to A4, B1, B3 to B5, C1 to C5, D1 to D4, E1 to E3, F1 and F2 © All lyrics copyright 1970 for the world by Harrisongs Music, Ltd., England. All rights for the United States and Canada controlled by Harrisongs Music, Inc.
A1, B2 © All lyrics copyright 1970 by Big Sky Music.

E2 is based upon Congratulations by Martin & Coulter.

Record 1 comes in a lilac; record 2 in a grey and record 3 in a mustard textured thick paper inner sleeve.
Each inner sleeve has "PRINTED IN U.S.A." printed in the bottom right corner.

Includes large poster of George with "PRINTED IN GREAT BRITAIN STCH 639" on bottom right corner.

Inside the box's cover front:
• 'Manufacturerd by Apple Records.Inc. 1700 Broadway, New York, New York 10019'.
• Eric Clapton is NOT yet listed for guitar (only George and Dave Mason are), but he appears on the mustard inner sleeve of record 3.

Runouts are stamped. Matrix # on labels in parentheses.
